item.title: Angela Okutoyi Sets Sights on LA 2028 Olympics
item.description: My main goal is to make it to LA through ranking rather than waiting for the African Games,” Okutoyi said.

item.title: New York Marathon Winner Albert Korir suspended over Drug Violation
item.description: Marathon world record holder Ruth Chepngetich was handed a three-year ban after testing positive for hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ) in March 2025.

item.title: Bullets Sign Uganda’s Shot Stopper Daisy Nakaziro
item.description: Nakaziro was instrumental in Kampala Queens’ title-winning season, setting a league record with 15 clean sheets, an outstanding run that earned her the Golden Glove award

item.title: Nairobi Dropped as Safari Rally Adjusts Route and Schedule
item.description: The WRC Safari Rally remains one of the championship’s most iconic and fan-favorite events. Steeped in history and heritage, the rally is globally respected for its unforgiving nature and uniqueness

item.title: Kenya in Tough Pool for Men’s Handball Africa Cup of Nations
item.description: Beyond the continental title, the championship carries significant global stakes, with the top five finishing teams earning qualification to the World Handball Championship in 2027.

item.title: Nairobi to Host 2026 Women’s African Volleyball Championships
item.description: The women’s championship returns to Nairobi after a 15-year hiatus, having last been held in the city in 2015 at the Moi International Sports Centre Indoor Arena.

item.title: Kenya Futsal Team To Face Nambia Ahead of Morocco AFCON
item.description: Should Kenya overcome Namibia, they will face Libya in the second and final round of qualification. This stage will also be contested over two legs

item.title: Kenya Drawn Against Estonia, Grenada and Hosts Rwanda in FIFA Series
item.description: FIFA Series forms part of Kenya’s broader preparations for the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) 2027, which will be co-hosted by Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania.

item.title: Naibois Face CAF Sanctions Amid Nyayo Electricity Issues
item.description: With uncertainty surrounding the restoration of power at the venue, Sports Kenya officials have reportedly advised Nairobi United to consider hiring generators to power the floodlights

item.title: Nairobi United vs Azam FC: How to Buy Tickets for CAF Confederation Cup Match
item.description: With CAF regulations ruling out ticket sales on match day and a crucial fixture looming, fans are encouraged to buy tickets early and turn out in large numbers to back Nairobi United at Nyayo Stadium.
